label: Threshold by linear extrapolation
subgoals: Find the bias of maximum transconductance in the linear sweep
Extrapolate the tangent there to zero current

label: Threshold from saturation data
subgoals: Take square roots of the two saturation currents
Find where the line through them crosses zero current
Report that intercept as the saturation threshold

section: The transconductance factor and staged fitting
subgoals: Compute the slope of the square root of current against gate voltage
Square it and double it to get K
Fit parameters stage by stage before a bounded global polish
